title: PNP remains full alert as travelers return after Asean long weekend

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) is maintaining full alert as thousands of commuters and motorists return to Metro Manila after the long weekend for the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits. “Our police units are prepared and have been directed to sustain heightened vigilance, strengthen police visibility, and intensify mobile patrols in major transport hubs, highways, and other areas where large crowds are expected,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said on Wednesday. Police units will remain on full alert until Thursday.
